_comment: Atlas classifications, glossary and Ranger tag masking for the rsingh_ogx_* databases, applied by scripts/governance.py. Only OGX_* classifications and rsingh-ogx-* policies are created or changed; other projects' tags and policies are left alone.

OGX_SENSITIVE_HASH.description: Person name (inspector, engineer, approver): masked users see a hash, so counts per inspector still work

OGX_SENSITIVE_LOCATION.description: Exact well or pipeline GPS coordinate: masked users see NULL (security of critical infrastructure)

OGX_SENSITIVE_SUBSURFACE.description: Subsurface data (seismic and well-log values, reservoir properties): commercially sensitive, masked users see NULL

OGX_SENSITIVE_TEXT.description: Free text extracted from documents (may name people or sites): letters become x, digits n

masking._comment: rsingh is in no masking policy and sees clear values

glossary.name: OGX Integrity KPIs
glossary.description: Certified asset-integrity KPIs of the O&G Asset Integrity Lakehouse. Each term is defined once (config/kpi.json) and assigned to its certified semantic view and the dashboard views that read it.
